Probably misclassified/misidentified. ECACC has discontinued this cell line because it displays STR profile from HEC-50B cells (Cellosaurus=CVCL_2929).
Partially contaminated. Some JCRB stocks were found to be from mouse (PubMed=20143388). Stock bought in 2013 was shown to be human by exome sequencing (personal communication of Rebouissou, Sandra).
Misclassified. Originally thought to be a mucinous gastric adenocarcinoma cell line from a 52 year old male patient but is a B-lymphoblastoid cell line (DSMZ; PubMed=30285677).
Misclassified. Originally thought to be a myeloma cell line and to be a sister line to KMS-21-PE (Cellosaurus=CVCL_A445) but this does not seem to be the case (PubMed=12592342; PubMed=20143388).
Contaminated. Shown to be a MCF-7 derivative (PubMed=18304946; PubMed=20143388).

Possibly misclassified. It is not certain that this cell line originate from a alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma (ARMS). It lacks the PAXA3-FOXO1 gene fusion characteristics of ARMS. Many papers classify it as an embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma (ERMS) and we accordingly describe it as such.
Contaminated. Parent cell line (MDA-MB-435) has been shown to be a M14 derivative.

Misidentified/contaminated. Shown to be identical to MEL-Wei. This cell line was reported to be isogenic with LCL-Ho (Cellosaurus=CVCL_1868) but it does not have the same STR profile (PubMed=10508494; PubMed=20143388). According to DSMZ ACC-62 it is a human female cell line.
Contaminated. NCI-H157 and NCI-H1264 have been shown to be identical.
Possibly contaminated. May be identical to OC 314 (Cellosaurus=CVCL_1616) according to STR profiling done at ICLC and to MSI data (PubMed=15677628).

Contaminated. Identical to OC 314 according to STR profiling done at ICLC, to MSI data (PubMed=15677628) and to omic data (DepMap). Originally thought to originate from a 60 year old patient with a FIGO stage IV ovarian cancer.
Contaminated. Shown to be a OVCAR-3 derivative (PubMed=20143388). Originally thought to originate from a 49 year old female patient with a thyroid gland papillary carcinoma.
Possibly misclassified. Originally thought to be a high grade ovarian serous adenocarcinoma but suspected to have a upper gastrointestinal origin (PubMed=27353327).

Partially contaminated. Some stocks of this cell line such as the one used by Sanger cell line project were contaminated with a OCUG-1 derivative as shown by STR profile and SNP fingerprinting analysis (DepMap).
Contaminated. Shown to be a PC-9 derivative (RCB=RCB0446).
Possibly misidentified. Presence of a Y chromosome in cell line that was thought to be of female origin (STR profile).
Partially contaminated. Some laboratories that are redistributing this cell line are in fact redistributing a contaminated cell line of mouse origin (PubMed=25182563).

Misclassified. Originally described as originating from an adenocarcinoma of liver and thus classified as hepatocellular carcinoma. Later studies show that it most probably has arisen from endothelial cells (PubMed=1371504; PubMed=31938418).
Misclassified. Originally thought to be a neuroblastoma cell line but shown to be from an Askin tumor (PubMed=20143388).
